description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Plates to cover the holes left by the removal of the old seat belt retractor mechanisms.
Just remove your existing Seat Belts and place the new plates back over the retractor housing holes.
Yes it uses the existing holes.- Comes with the attachment screws
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Plate, Retractor Mechanism
Qty 8 – Screws, Plate, Retractor Mechanism
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
